Pakistan summons Imran Khan's sister over remarks on army and India

Pakistan's National Cyber Crime Investigation Agency issued a summons to Noreen Niazi, sister of former Prime Minister Imran Khan, on July 19, 2026. She is required to appear at the agency's Islamabad office on July 20, 2026, to record her statement. The summons follows Niazi's remarks concerning the Pakistani army and a potential conflict with India, including allegations of collusion between Indian Prime Minister Modi and the Pakistani military. Niazi also claimed that the Pakistani military fabricated a "victory narrative" regarding "Operation Sindoor," stating it was India's success and that the Pakistani army hid its defeat.
